text:
elaine: VoltChip asked for a reproducible perf/W package we can ship to marketplace. They want the headline stat on perf/W for a 10B profile.

diego: Let's lock down the test harness and cooling notes. My checklist: model redwood-10b fp16, seq 512, kv-cache preheated, 3x steady runs (600s after warmup). Measure wall power via PDUs.

sam: I have a kernel tune that affects tensor-layout and L2 prefetch. Expect ~9% perf/W improvement. Will push a preview commit and a smoke command.

sam: ```
# smoke command
./bench --model=redwood-10b --seq=512 --duration=900 \
  --collect=tokens_per_s,power,watt_stddev --kernel=layout-prefetch-v1 \
  --warmup=180 --runs=3 \
  --out=artifacts/voltchip-watt.csv
```

voltchip-qa: We'll join the test call Tue 9am PT with our QA lead. We'll also send rack cooling config and PDU IDs. Note: our rack uses 480V PDUs, reported as wall watts.

elaine: Acceptance thresholds proposal: sustained >= 11 tokens/s/W across 3 runs, tokens/s >= 10k per rack, p99 <= 300ms. If we miss perf/W but kernel shows uplift, we can add an "upcoming kernel" note in the blog but tile must show verified numbers only.

ops-bot: Created ticket LEGAL-620. ETA 48h for co-announcement review. Calendar invite sent for Tue 9am PT cross-org test.

diego: Action items: sam run the 3x sweeps and paste CSV + mean/std by Mon 4pm PT; voltchip-qa provide rack spec and hero image by Mon EOD; legal handles co-announcement.

elaine: Thanks. Keep numbers raw in artifacts folder; we'll redact sensitive telemetry before public release. Ping here with results. :rocket:
